manufacturing_transformations.note: Active C2R1 P007 is one monolithic machined 316L part with integral blind end. Legacy welded-construction decomposition is superseded by EDR-025; no sleeve/flange manufacturing subitems are created.

principles: CAD owns modeled occurrence and quantity.
control/product/parts.json owns identity and product metadata.
Non-modeled required items are explicit registry inclusions.
Suppressed CAD occurrences never disappear silently; disposition is mandatory.
EBOM and MBOM are separate derived views and never silently overwrite one another.

release_logic.MBOM: Required for manufacturing-release handoff; may remain HOLD while engineering drawings are being closed.
